dialogues.title: Eczanede öksürük
dialogues.scene: You are in a pharmacy in London; you have a cough.

turns.say: Hello, how can I help you?
options: I have a cough since yesterday.
I am cough from yesterday.
I've had a cough since yesterday.
turns.why: 'Since' ile present perfect kullanılır: I've had a cough since yesterday.

options: No, I don't think so.
No, I am not temperature.
No, I don't have a temperature think.
turns.why: 'I don't think so' sanmıyorum demektir; kısa ve doğal bir yanıttır.

turns.say: Take two of these tablets three times a day.
turns.tr: Bu tabletlerden günde üç kez ikişer tane alın.
options: OK, I take three times.
OK, before or after meals?
OK, two tablets are day.
turns.why: 'Before or after meals?' ilacın zamanını sorar.
turns.replyTr: Tamam, yemekten önce mi sonra mı?

turns.say: After meals, with plenty of water.
options: Great, how much am I?
Great, what is the price it?
Great, thanks. How much is it?
turns.why: Fiyat için 'How much is it?' denir.

options: Here you are. Have a nice day!
Here I am. Nice day!
Here you are six pounds day.

dialogues.title: Taksiyle otele
dialogues.scene: You get into a taxi at the airport.

options: I go to Grand Hotel.
To the Grand Hotel, please.
Grand Hotel is where.
Yes, I'm here since a week.
Yes, I am holiday.
Yes, I'm here for a week.
turns.why: Süre için 'for a week' denir; 'since' başlangıç noktası ister.

turns.say: There's quite a lot of traffic today.
options: That's fine, I'm not in a hurry.
That's fine, I have no hurry.
That's fine, I am in hurry.
turns.why: 'I'm not in a hurry' acelem yok demektir.

turns.say: We'll be there in about ten minutes.
options: Perfect, I'll be there ten minutes.
Perfect, thank you very much.
Thank you, ten minutes are there.

turns.say: Here we are. That's twenty pounds.
options: Keep my change, thanks!
Take the change for you!
Keep the change, thanks!

dialogues.title: Otelde kalorifer bozuk
dialogues.scene: The heating in your hotel room does not work; you go to reception.

turns.say: Good evening, can I help you?
options: Good evening, my room heating doesn't work it.
Good evening, the heating is not worked.
Good evening, the heating in my room isn't working.

turns.say: I'm very sorry. What's your room number?
options: It's room three hundred and five.
I'm room three hundred and five.
Room is three hundred and five me.

turns.say: I'll send someone up right away.
options: Thanks, I send someone in a few minutes.
Thanks, could they come in a few minutes?
Thanks, someone is sent right away me.
turns.replyTr: Teşekkürler, birkaç dakika sonra gelebilirler mi?

turns.say: Of course. Would you like to move to another room in the meantime?
turns.tr: Elbette. Bu arada başka bir odaya geçmek ister misiniz?
options: No, thanks, I'd rather to wait here.
Yes, thanks, I'm in the meantime.
No, thanks, I'd rather wait here.
turns.why: 'I'd rather + yalın fiil' (to yok) tercih belirtir.
turns.replyTr: Hayır, teşekkürler, burada beklemeyi tercih ederim.

turns.say: Understood. We'll offer you breakfast tomorrow, on the house.
options: That's very kind of you, thank you.
That's very kind for you, thanks you.
Thank you the breakfast.
turns.why: 'That's very kind of you' bir iyiliğe verilen kalıp yanıttır.
